P.name: Joy Unending
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Nilah''' [[kill]]s a {{tip|minion}}, she and the nearest allied {{tip|champion}} gain an additional {{sti|{{as|50% of the experience}}}} they would have lost from sharing.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a nearby allied champion uses an {{tip|ability}} to {{tip|heal}} or {{tip|shield}} either '''Nilah''' or themselves, both they and '''Nilah''' receive a '''bonus''' amount equal to {{fd|7.5}}% of the healing or 15% of the shielding after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. '''Bonus''' shielding lasts as long as the shield that triggered the effect, up to a maximum duration of 4 seconds.

Q.name: Formless Blade
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Nilah''' gains {{sti|lethality|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 30 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.3% per 1% critical strike chance, capped at 100% critical strike chance|color=critical chance}}}} {{as|armor penetration}}. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} and ''Formless Blade'' {{tip|heal}} her for {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|0 to 20 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.2% per 1% critical strike chance, capped at 100% critical strike chance|color=critical chance}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to {{tip|champions}}, converting each heal instance beyond {{as|'''maximum''' health}} into a {{tip|shield}} that lasts 6 seconds.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' cracks her whip-blade in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 70|critScaling=true}}. ''Formless Blade'' can hit {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness to one target.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|0 to 40}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|0*1.91 to 40*1.91}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*1.91}}% AD)}}}}
Q.description3: If ''Formless Blade'' is cast during ''{{ai|Slipstream|Nilah}}'', '''Nilah''' leaves behind a wave that is sent towards her location at the end of the dash, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
Q.description4: If ''Formless Blade'' hits an enemy, '''Nilah''' empowers herself for 4 seconds: gaining {{sti|range|125 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{sti|attack speed|{{as|{{pp|10 to 60|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and causing her basic attacks to strike in a cone that deals {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Against secondary non-champion targets, this is reduced to {{as|{{ap|100*0.33}}% AD}} for {{tip|minions}}, and additionally executes minions left below {{sti|{{as|20 health}}}}. {{tip|On-hit}} effects are applied only to the primary target.
Q.cast time: {{dv|{{tt|{{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|round=3|0.35;0.33;0.297;0.28|key1=%|0;13.72;36.358;48|changedisplay=true|formula=0.35-0.035 per 24% '''bonus''' attack speed)). ''This is capped at 20% reduction at 48% '''bonus''' attack speed.''}}|attack speed}}}}|{{tt|None|When cast during Slipstream}}}}

W.name: Jubilant Veil
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' envelops herself in mist for {{fd|2.25}} seconds, during which she becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, reduces all incoming {{as|magic damage}} taken by 25%, and {{tip|dodge|dodges}} all non-{{tip|turret}} basic attacks.
W.description2: Allied champions {{tt|she touches|Being within collision range of them}} will also be enveloped for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, gaining the same effects.

E.name: Slipstream
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target unit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through.
E.description2: '''Nilah''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Slipstream'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description3: ''Slipstream {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nilah's''' basic attack timer. {{ai|Formless Blade|Nilah}} and {{ai|Apotheosis|Nilah}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Apotheosis
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nilah''' whirls her whip-blade over 1 second, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. She then unleashes a burst that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them 250 units towards her. Each hit also {{tip|slows}} targets by 10% for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
R.description2: '''Nilah''' {{tip|heals}} herself and nearby allied champions for {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|20 to 50 for 11|0 to 100|formula=20% + 0.3% per 1% critical strike chance, capped at 100% critical strike chance|color=critical chance}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to {{tip|champions}}, reduced to 10% against non-champions, converting each heal instance beyond {{as|'''maximum''' health}} into a {{tip|shield}} that last 6 seconds.
R.description3: '''''Nilah''' is unable to basic attack and cast her other [[champion ability|abilities]] during Apotheosis, but she is able to move.''
